user.title: Tuya Cloud
user.description:
Enter the User Code from the Smart Life or Tuya app. It is usually under Me/Profile > Settings > Account and Security > User Code.

⚠️ Initial sensor values may be unavailable for about one minute. Opening the device page in the Tuya app can trigger faster updates.

scan.title: Scan QR Code
scan.description:
Use the Smart Life or Tuya app to scan this QR code.

After scanning, return here and submit this step.

If the QR code expires, submit again to generate a new one.
